admin_access_warning: Grants all permissions. Handle with care
description: Manage policies that group permission rules.
detail_description: Edit the permission row's collection / action / fields / row filter.
filter_json_help_combination: Multiple policies are combined additively. Row filters are combined with OR, and fields are combined as a union. If any policy has admin_access=true, all permissions are granted.
filter_json_help_variables: Dynamic variables: $CURRENT_USER / $NOW / $CURRENT_ROLE. Operators: _eq _neq _lt _lte _gt _gte _in _nin _null _nnull _contains _icontains _starts_with _ends_with _between _nbetween _empty _nempty. _and / _or can be nested.
grid_scope_note: These settings belong to this policy alone. What a person can actually do is the sum of every policy attached to them.
invalid_filter_json: Enter a valid JSON row filter
permission_delete_lost: This row filter will be deleted as well.
row_all_confirm: Only cells without conditions will be allowed. Cells with conditions are left as they are.
row_none_confirm: The row filters and field lists you wrote will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
